result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on where your business operates, how many employees you pay, and whether you want to manage payroll yourself or automate everything.

**My recommendation is to choose a full-service payroll platform** that handles tax calculations, payslips, pension contributions, tax reporting and compliance—not just wage calculations.

One important distinction: payroll software for a UK business is very different from software designed for US businesses.

## Best payroll software in the UK (2026)

Here are the five I'd shortlist\:

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall)

Good for small businesses wanting standalone payroll, HMRC reporting, payslips and pension auto-enrolment.

Indicative price: from £12/month for five employees.

[Sage website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Xero Payroll**

(Best for Xero users)

Ideal if you already use Xero for bookkeeping. Payroll integrates with your accounts.

Pricing depends on your Xero subscription and employee numbers.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. BrightPay**

(Best dedicated payroll)

Excellent option for businesses wanting specialist payroll features, pension administration and detailed payroll processing.

Cloud pricing available on request.

[BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Quickbooks Logo Png | Quickbooks Logo Vector  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EgpRGTuKXM9JBQhBxDeBmotPOK2V1CAxW6csrlBGPGPM15pztH3eOcpEVWcqc6mS0O1OJQxiy3rYDKVoibK-tXZzwx_-fnc0UCKsZf5bUQtlgBDTtK7dsXwaLO2yAIKNfloGWbyBHt0g2gG5iJtWLQko_1xFOodwaVRw5Zh1K1GZ7uleuWwINKnPwp3V07V7?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for QuickBooks users)

Convenient if your accounts and bookkeeping are already managed through QuickBooks.

Indicative price: £5/month plus employee charges.

[QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![Employment Hero Logo & Brand Assets (SVG, PNG and vector) - Brandfetch](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Z6qVhSSYF5CYFaR38tVZ9vpu364SrI1qcU-LhtFo5MrKvM2IIECP5NGDLvCA9qSi3OHN3nIGoWj3sOAoSGJ3TbpMzqye4Jq3Q2-1Ae4X05g3VDo154uJn7RkzUUAY3Xfi51rzm16rZPnUZ2NnrKj1KHaQU4ePGT94fhowd8mNNeyff58VJ3Le5GJh2e89NE4?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Employment Hero**

(Best for HR and payroll together)

Useful if you want payroll, employee records, leave management and HR features in one system.

A free payroll option is advertised; check the plan's limitations.

[Employment Hero website](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

Prices are indicative and exclude VAT where applicable.

## What I would choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 employees | Sage |
| 5–20 employees | Sage or BrightPay |
| Already use Xero | Xero Payroll |
| Already use QuickBooks | QuickBooks Payroll |
| Want payroll and HR together | Employment Hero |
| Want to minimise costs | HMRC Basic PAYE Tools (limited functionality) |


Make sure whichever platform you choose supports HMRC Real Time Information (RTI), statutory payments and workplace pension auto-enrolment where applicable.
